/**
 * PKC2 の **本物の writer** を直接動かして、全 8 形式の実体を作る。
 * ⚠ PKC2 のソースは import するだけ(read-only)。書き込みは PKC3 側の fixtures へ。
 */
import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { buildPackageZip } from '/home/user/PKC2/src/adapter/platform/zip-package.ts';
import { buildTextBundle, buildTextsContainerBundle } from '/home/user/PKC2/src/adapter/platform/text-bundle.ts';
import {
  buildTextlogBundle,
  buildTextlogsContainerBundle,
} from '/home/user/PKC2/src/adapter/platform/textlog-bundle.ts';
import { buildMixedContainerBundle } from '/home/user/PKC2/src/adapter/platform/mixed-bundle.ts';
import { buildFolderExportBundle } from '/home/user/PKC2/src/adapter/platform/folder-export.ts';
import { buildEntryBundle } from '/home/user/PKC2/src/adapter/platform/entry-bundle.ts';

const OUT = '/home/user/PKC3/tests/fixtures/pkc2';
mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });

const b64 = (s: string): string => Buffer.from(s, 'utf-8').toString('base64');
// 1x1 PNG
const PNG = 'iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==';

const now = new Date('2026-07-31T12:00:00.000Z');

/** 実運用に近い container(フォルダ階層 + 共有添付 + 履歴 + 各 archetype)。 */
const container: any = {
  meta: { container_id: 'cid-real', title: '実データ', schema_version: 1 },
  entries: [
    { lid: 'f-root', title: '仕事', archetype: 'folder', body: '' },
    { lid: 'f-2026', title: '2026 年', archetype: 'folder', body: '' },
    { lid: 'f-empty', title: '空フォルダ', archetype: 'folder', body: '' },
    {
      lid: 'n-1',
      title: '議事録',
      archetype: 'text',
      body: '# 議事録\n\n![図](asset:ast-shared)\n\n- 決定事項\n',
      created_at: '2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z',
      tags: ['会議'],
      color_tag: 'blue',
    },
    {
      lid: 'n-2',
      title: '直下メモ',
      archetype: 'text',
      body: '# 直下メモ\n\nこちらも ![図](asset:ast-shared)\n',
    },
    {
      lid: 'g-1',
      title: '作業ログ',
      archetype: 'textlog',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        entries: [
          { id: 'l1', text: '着手した', createdAt: '2026-07-01T01:00:00.000Z', flags: [] },
          { id: 'l2', text: '**重要**な発見', createdAt: '2026-07-01T02:00:00.000Z', flags: ['important'] },
        ],
      }),
    },
    {
      lid: 't-1',
      title: 'やること',
      archetype: 'todo',
      body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'open', description: '段⑥ を書く', date: '2026-08-10' }),
    },
    {
      lid: 'a-1',
      title: 'dot.png',
      archetype: 'attachment',
      body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'dot.png', mime: 'image/png', size: 68, asset_key: 'ast-shared' }),
    },
  ],
  relations: [
    { id: 'r1', from: 'f-root', to: 'f-2026', kind: 'structural' },
    { id: 'r2', from: 'f-root', to: 'f-empty', kind: 'structural' },
    { id: 'r3', from: 'f-2026', to: 'n-1', kind: 'structural' },
    { id: 'r4', from: 'f-root', to: 'n-2', kind: 'structural' },
    { id: 'r5', from: 'f-2026', to: 'g-1', kind: 'structural' },
    { id: 'r6', from: 'f-root', to: 't-1', kind: 'structural' },
    { id: 'r7', from: 'n-1', to: 'n-2', kind: 'semantic' },
  ],
  revisions: [
    { id: 'rv1', entry_lid: 'n-1', created_at: '2026-07-02T00:00:00.000Z', snapshot: '# 議事録\n\n古い本文\n' },
    { id: 'rv2', entry_lid: 'n-1', created_at: '2026-07-03T00:00:00.000Z', snapshot: '# 議事録\n\nもう少し新しい\n' },
  ],
  assets: { 'ast-shared': PNG },
};

const save = async (name: string, blobOrBytes: any): Promise<void> => {
  const buf =
    blobOrBytes instanceof Uint8Array
      ? Buffer.from(blobOrBytes)
      : Buffer.from(await blobOrBytes.arrayBuffer());
  writeFileSync(`${OUT}/${name}`, buf);
  console.log(`${name}\t${buf.length} bytes`);
};

const folder = (lid: string): any => container.entries.find((e: any) => e.lid === lid);
const entry = (lid: string): any => container.entries.find((e: any) => e.lid === lid);

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  // #1 pkc2-package
  await save('package.pkc2.zip', buildPackageZip(container));

  // #2 .text.zip(単体)
  await save('single.text.zip', buildTextBundle(entry('n-1'), container, { now }).zipBytes);

  // #3 .textlog.zip(単体)
  await save('single.textlog.zip', buildTextlogBundle(entry('g-1'), container, { now }).zipBytes);

  // #4 texts container bundle
  await save('texts-container.zip', buildTextsContainerBundle(container, { now }).blob);

  // #5 textlogs container bundle
  await save('textlogs-container.zip', buildTextlogsContainerBundle(container, { now }).blob);

  // #6 mixed container bundle
  await save('mixed-container.zip', buildMixedContainerBundle(container, { now }).blob);

  // #7 folder-export(todo が居るので **v2** になるはず)
  await save('folder-export-v2.zip', buildFolderExportBundle(folder('f-root'), container, { now }).blob);

  // #7' folder-export v1(todo を外した container = text/textlog だけ)
  const v1Container = {
    ...container,
    entries: container.entries.filter((e: any) => e.lid !== 't-1'),
    relations: container.relations.filter((r: any) => r.to !== 't-1'),
  };
  await save('folder-export-v1.zip', buildFolderExportBundle(folder('f-root'), v1Container, { now }).blob);

  // #8 .entry.zip(単体 ── PKC2 に読む実装が無い形式)
  await save('single.entry.zip', buildEntryBundle(entry('t-1'), container).zipBytes);

}
void main();
